body.name: package

ops.fn:
async function(tap, args) {
  const packageName = args.package || "@xquik/tweetclaw"
  const encoded = encodeURIComponent(packageName)
  const data = await tap.fetch(`https://registry.npmjs.org/${encoded}`)
  const latestVersion = data["dist-tags"]?.latest || ""
  const latest = latestVersion ? data.versions?.[latestVersion] || {} : {}
  const repository = typeof latest.repository === "string"
    ? latest.repository
    : latest.repository?.url || data.repository?.url || ""
  const normalizedRepository = repository
    .replace(/^git\+/, "")
    .replace(/\.git$/, "")
  const openclawSpec = latest.openclaw?.install?.npmSpec || data.openclaw?.install?.npmSpec || ""
  return [{
    name: data.name || packageName,
    version: latest.version || latestVersion,
    description: latest.description || data.description || "",
    license: latest.license || data.license || "",
    npm_install: `npm install ${data.name || packageName}`,
    openclaw_install: openclawSpec ? `openclaw plugins install npm:${openclawSpec}` : "",
    repository: normalizedRepository,
    homepage: latest.homepage || data.homepage || "",
    keywords: Array.isArray(latest.keywords) ? latest.keywords.join(", ") : ""
  }]
}

body.description: npm package metadata with OpenClaw plugin install info when available
